title: AI helper: free models turn idea-box suggestions into small, checked changes (run by hand)
body:
An experiment: can a **free** AI model turn a visitor's idea (an issue labelled `suggestion`) into a small, correct change? Run by hand on a laptop; nothing is automated, and nothing changes on the live site.

## What's in it (`scripts/ai/`, see its README)

- **`spec`**: a sorting prompt turns an idea into a short, exact plan that names a recipe, or answers `needs-person` with a reason. It uses Gemini's free tier and falls back to Workers AI's free allowance when out of quota.
- **`build`**: Aider makes the planned change, seeing only the recipe's file, and runs the recipe's test until it passes.
- **Recipes**: one kind of small change each: a neighbor's voice, a crow stop, a busker song. Each names the file it may edit, its rules, a worked example and its test. Every example passes its own test.
- **Checks that don't trust the model** (`lib.mjs`, tested):
  - the idea is quoted as data, never as instructions;
  - known recipes only;
  - only the recipe's file may change;
  - never `.github/`, `relay/`, `wish/`, `src/city/`, `scripts/` or `public/`;
  - at most 80 changed lines;
  - the tests and `tsc` must pass.
- Keys come only from the environment. `.ai/` and `.aider*` are gitignored. CLAUDE.md gets a short pointer.

Free tiers only: Gemini with billing off, then Workers AI. No paid models.

## Tested

- `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- Each recipe's example, applied for real, passes its test and `tsc`.
- `--dry-run` output checked for both commands.
- `build` run end to end with a fake Aider:
  - a good change passes every check;
  - an extra edit to `relay/` is rejected.
- **Not yet run against a real model.** That needs a free Gemini key. Next: `node scripts/ai/run.mjs spec 12` on a laptop.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commits.message:
AI helper: spec + build prompts, three recipes, and the checks around them

Prompts and recipes for turning a visitor's idea into a small, exact change that a free
model can make: a spec pass (idea → plan or needs-person), a build pass, and recipes for a
neighbor's voice, a crow stop and a busker song. lib.mjs holds the checks that don't rely
on the prompt (quoting the idea, known recipes only, only the recipe's file, never
.github/relay/wish/src/city, at most 80 changed lines), tested.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: the runner (spec → plan, build → Aider + checks), free providers only

scripts/ai/run.mjs: spec <issue> (or --idea) asks Gemini's free tier, falling back to
Workers AI when out of quota, for a plan that names a recipe (one retry when the answer
doesn't fit); build <issue> runs Aider with only the recipe's files and its test, then
checks the diff (recipe file only, nothing forbidden, at most 80 lines) and runs the test
and tsc. --dry-run calls nothing. Keys only from the environment; nothing committed.
README for trying it by hand; .ai/ and .aider* gitignored; a pointer in CLAUDE.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: default to gemini-3.8-flash; a retired model says so and names the replacement

gemini-2.5-flash is closed to new keys (404). The runner now reports a missing model with
the replacement the error suggests and moves on to the next provider; README installs
Aider with uv.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: retry a busy free model (3 s, 10 s, 30 s), and list usable models

A 503 "high demand" from Gemini's free tier is now retried before moving on to the next
provider. run.mjs models lists the model names each key can use, for --model.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: build --idea builds the last spec --idea, so trying it needs no public issue

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: when no provider answers, say why (busy, quota, retired model) and what to try

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: try older Flash models when the newest is busy; build reuses the one that answered

gemini-3.8-flash is often at capacity on the free tier. spec now tries 3.8, 3.7, 3.6, 3.5
and flash-lite-latest in turn (one short retry each, the full wait on the last), and build
uses the model that wrote the plan.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: plans see the recipes in full and can't name made-up files; the recipe wins

A real run planned neighbor-voice but invented .ai/neighbors.txt, src/game/neighbors.test.ts
and an id field. The spec prompt now carries every recipe in full; checkSpec rejects a plan
naming files outside its recipe (and spec retries once with that reason); the build prompt
says the recipe wins over the plan, and always lists the recipe's own test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: Aider sees only the recipe's files, so a file name in a comment can't stop the edit

A real build printed the right change but never saved it: the file's comment mentions
src/game/busker.ts, Aider offered to add it, --yes-always accepted, and Aider re-asked the
model instead of applying the edit. An aiderignore that hides everything but the recipe's
files stops that (reproduced with a fake model, then fixed).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: a cut-off reply can't wreck a file; neighbor-voice gets a test that reads the file

A real build saved a reply cut off part way, chopping neighbors.ts in half; the type check
caught it, but the recipe's test (content.test.ts) passed because it never loads that file.
Now: src/content/neighbors.test.ts checks every voice (a name, 1–3 lines under 100
characters, no emoji/links/"press A") and is the recipe's test; Aider uses search/replace
edits, so a cut-off reply fails to apply; and checkDiff fails a build that removes more
than 3 lines.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: vlandham

commits.message:
AI helper: a crow stop must match exactly one shop; the quota message names the model

The crow test only checked that a stop's pattern matched some shop, so /bakery/i (two
shops) would pass. It now requires exactly one (all current stops do). The out-of-quota
message names the model, since newer Gemini models hit smaller daily limits first.
